slug: 2024-01-01 On the functioning of Equatorial Guinea's National Centre for the Issuance of Official Documents (CNEDOGE)

systems.system: CNEDOGE issuance of biometric official documents (DIP, passports, residence cards, civil-servant cards)
systems.owner: CNEDOGE, an autonomous public entity created by Decree 24/2010, attached to the Ministry of National Security
systems.tiers: seat in Malabo; mandated to install and manage issuing and verification devices nationwide and at diplomatic and consular missions

note: An explainer on the identity-document issuing centre; nothing on civil registration.
